title: Windows kernel driver registered outside the system drivers folder
description: A kernel or file-system driver's image path points outside System32\drivers and the DriverStore. Vulnerable or malicious drivers dropped by an attacker (bring-your-own-vulnerable-driver) are often registered from unusual paths.
benign_explanations: Hypervisors, anti-cheat, backup and security products install drivers under Program Files
OEM utilities that ship their own driver folder
